name: Definition of the SI kilogram by fixing the Planck constant
description: The CGPM fixed the numerical value of the Planck constant at 6.626 070 15 × 10⁻³⁴ joule seconds as part of the revised SI. Together with the definitions of the metre and second, this defines the kilogram.

date.label: 16 November 2018
date.basis: The official proceedings date the vote on Resolution 1 to the seventh session.

events.statement: The 26th CGPM unanimously adopted Resolution 1 on the revised SI, including the fixed numerical value of the Planck constant.

evidence.locator: 16 November 2018, item 54, French p. 204 and English p. 465
evidence.supports: The CGPM voted to adopt Draft Resolution A as Resolution 1 on this date.

evidence.locator: Resolution 1, English pp. 472–474, decision and Appendices 1–3
evidence.supports: The revised definition took effect from 20 May 2019, replacing the IPK definition and fixing h exactly.

date.label: 20 May 2019
date.basis: Resolution 1 specifies when the revised SI definitions take effect.

events.statement: The fixed-constant definition of the kilogram took effect and the definition based on the International Prototype of the Kilogram was abrogated.
events.scope: The operative SI definition. National laboratory realization and dissemination have their own records and dates.

evidence.locator: Resolution 1, English pp. 472–474, decision and Appendices 1–3

earliest_record.rationale: The CGPM adopted the definite rule at the recorded vote. Its effective date followed in 2019.

links.statement: Member-state delegates revised the SI through the General Conference on Weights and Measures created under the Metre Convention.
links.scope: The institutional authority and international decision process for this definition.

evidence.locator: Convention Art. 3 and Annexed Regulations Art. 7
evidence.supports: Article 3 establishes the CGPM’s authority. The Annex states its mandate to develop the metric system and approve new metrological determinations.
